name: Goblin Scout
lore: A weak but nimble scout of the goblin horde. Usually found patrolling the upper floors, wielding rusted swords.

name: Orc Cleaver
lore: Brutish warriors who rely on raw strength. Their heavy axes can shatter frail defenses with ease.

name: Skeleton Spearman
lore: Reanimated remains of fallen soldiers. They maintain their martial discipline, attacking with long-reaching lances.

name: Goblin Archer
lore: A fragile but annoying goblin equipped with a crude bow, striking from afar.

name: Hobgoblin Raider
lore: Larger and more organized than their goblin kin. They coordinate their attacks to overwhelm intruders.

name: Dark Cultist
lore: Fanatical followers of the dark arts. They hurl volatile magic from a distance.

name: Orc Berserker
lore: Fueled by sheer rage, these orcs abandon all defense to deliver devastating, reckless swings with their greataxes.

name: Spectral Lancer
lore: Ethereal spirits bound to the dungeon. Their ghostly lances pierce through armor as if it were not there.

name: Dread Knight
lore: Elite undead warriors clad in dark, impenetrable armor. Their heavy swords carry the chill of the grave.

name: Iron Golem
lore: A towering construct of iron and magic. Slow but immensely durable, armed with an integrated axe-blade.

name: Phantom Halberdier
lore: Vengeful phantoms of ancient royal guards. They strike with terrifying precision using elongated halberds.

name: Cinder Imp
lore: A volatile entity formed from molten magma and sulfur. When close to intruders, it ignites a deadly self-destruct fuse.

name: 💀 Dread Minotaur (FOE)
lore: A terrifying FOE that wanders the early floors. Its colossal axe and immense strength make it a deadly encounter.

name: 💀 Shadow Reaper (FOE)
lore: An elite shadow entity that stalks the dark corridors. Its sweeping scythe-like lance cuts through the unwary.

name: 💀 Crimson Warlord (FOE)
lore: A blood-soaked general of the dungeon's armies. This elite FOE challenges only the strongest of adventurers.

name: 👹 DREAD CHAMPION (BOSS)
lore: The mid-tier boss ruling over the 5th floor. A hulking monstrosity wielding an axe forged in the deepest abysses.

name: 👑 SHADOW SOVEREIGN (FINAL BOSS)
lore: The ultimate ruler of Wardwake. Its dark sword brings oblivion, commanding the shadows to consume all intruders.
